s.h: WE’D LIKE TO HEAR FROM YOU
s.t:
If you are passionate about our mission but don’t see the right opportunity, please check back as our needs are always evolving.

If you need assistance or an accommodation to complete the application process due to a disability, please contact us here.

At Mithun, we approach the hiring process as a chance for you to get to know us, our interdisciplinary approach and the wide range of projects we engage in to make a positive impact in people’s lives. It’s also our opportunity to learn about you — your experience, talents, skills and potential to help shape our mission-driven work.

After you apply online through our Careers page, we review your application materials to learn about your background, experience and passions. We consider all applications, and if there’s a match between your background and our current needs, you may be invited to complete additional steps in the hiring process, including some or all of the following:

Phone Conversation: An initial 30-minute phone call to connect and explore your interests and the open position(s).
First Interview: A 45-60 minute in-person or video meeting with our team to discuss your experience. This includes a portfolio review (for design positions), discussion of your relevant experience, your design/work approach, and how you solve challenges. Team members can answer your questions and share direct information about what it’s like to work at Mithun. We’re happy to offer tips if you’re new to portfolio reviews or want guidance on how to prepare.
Second Interview: Another conversation (45-60 minutes) with additional team members to dive deeper into your skills, knowledge and interests, as well as answer your remaining questions. Occasionally, we may invite you to a third interview.
Offer Decision: We will check references, select the most suitable candidate for the position and present an offer.

We are committed to making our recruitment process fair, accessible and encouraging. Our goal is for you to leave each step feeling informed, respected and excited about the possibility of joining our team.

Stoss is a Cooper-Hewitt National Design Award winner for landscape architecture and urbanism projects that address some of today's most pressing needs, including climate change and adaptation, social and racial equity, and the advancement of a multifunctional public realm.

s.h: NEW YORK – 3-6+ YEARS EXPERIENCE LANDSCAPE ARCHITECT/DESIGNER
s.t:
NYC Landscape Architect/Designers with 3-6+ years’ experience

Join a collaborative New York studio where emerging landscape architects grow through hands-on design, detailed construction documentation, field experience, planting design, and mentorship on highly crafted residential, hospitality, rooftop, and institutional projects.

Dynamic Growth Opportunities: At Hollander Design, you’ll be part of a dynamic and growing team, designing exciting projects across the United States and internationally. From private residences, urban rooftops, and institutional campuses to historic landscapes, luxury real estate and hospitality, you’ll have ample opportunities for professional growth, creativity, and to see your projects completed.
Commitment to Excellence: We believe in delivering best-in-class landscape architecture that seamlessly integrates with the site, its architecture, and the unique needs of its inhabitants. Our family-first work environment fosters collaboration, creativity, and a healthy work-life balance.
Industry Leadership: With a portfolio that includes prestigious accolades from the ASLA, recognition in the Architectural Digest AD 100 and Elle Decor lists, and a national hospitality design award for our biodiverse approach to Silver Sands, among others, we are at the forefront of our industry.

Competitive Compensation: As a valued member of our team, you’ll receive a competitive salary commensurate with your expertise and contributions.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes matching contributions to a 401k, performance-based bonuses, and generous health insurance coverage.

Grow With Us in New York

Embark on a fulfilling career path with Hollander Design in vibrant New York. Immerse yourself in a city known for its rich cultural tapestry, architectural marvels, and endless opportunities for inspiration.

Enthusiasm for working in a collaborative studio environment on a wide range of project types.

Urban rooftops, terraces, or private gardens.

High-end residential design.
Planting design and plant material selection.
Hand rendering, digital rendering, or advanced visualization.
Rhino, Lumion, D5, or other 3D modeling/rendering platforms.
Professional licensure or progress toward licensure.

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be a Landscape Architect/Urban Planner? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects
Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.
The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

s.h: On top of that, you’ll have
s.t:
Actively pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Urban/Landscape Architecture field or similar.
Have good problem-solving skills
Be a creative and technical thinker
Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

Sustainability, materials & reuse
BIM, Revit, design & sketching
Client consultancy & tendering
Restoration & building preservation
Competitions & visualizations
Descriptions & quality assurance
Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more
At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?
If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out Ane Juul Gram for Aarhus/Aalborg and Annet Sherin Expethit for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.
We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable.

We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Kindly submit your CV, Cover Letter, and Portfolio. As only two attachment fields are available on the application page, please combine files where needed and upload them accordingly.

As a Landscape Architect you will: Function as the NIH Chief Landscape Architect. Provide guidance and consultation on all aspects of landscape design, site development, and landscape maintenance.

Develop detailed plans, sketches, and specifications, and review current ground maintenance contract specifications for seasonal maintenance and improvement plans. In order to meet the Basic Qualifications for a Landscape Architect, GS-0807 position, you must: A. have a degree with a major in Landscape Architect or Landscape design; OR B. have a combination of education and experience that includes, for each year short of graduation, at least 1 year of experience under professional leadership and guidance of such character and diversity as to be a satisfactory substitute for the required education.

This experience must have included original landscape design.

In addition to the above, in order to qualify for a Landscape Architect position at the GS-0807-13 level, you must have 1 year of specialized experience at or at least equivalent to the GS-12 level in the Federal service obtained in either the private or public sector, performing the following types of tasks: 1) Providing technical advice and guidance on landscape design, site development, and landscape maintenance; 2) administering fertilization, maintenance, and integrated pest management programs; 3) establishing long-range landscape development plans in accordance with federal, state, and local laws; 4) performing site visits to determine impacts of projects on landscape master plans; 5) developing regenerative landscape designs and visualizations.

You will receive credit for all experience material to the position, including experience gained in religious, civic, welfare, service, and organizational activities, regardless of whether you received pay.
